objective: Extend installed-project provenance to legacy editable installs without guessing a distribution or import name from repository identity.

frozen_observation.collector_gap: Two bootstrap-success cases had no PEP 610 direct_url.json match; both remained unknown as required.
frozen_observation.infrastructure_failures_excluded: The two files.pythonhosted.org ReadTimeout failures are handled by a separate identical-retry protocol and do not motivate this policy change.

accepted_legacy_evidence: An installed site-packages `*.egg-link` whose first non-empty line resolves to /data/project or a descendant.
A project-root distribution discoverable from project-owned `.egg-info` metadata.
A unique PEP 503 canonical-name match between the egg-link filename and project-owned distribution Name.
content_addressing: SHA-256 of the matched egg-link payload
Existing composite hash of METADATA, top_level.txt, and entry_points.txt
rejections: zero or multiple matching project distributions
unchanged: Round 3 smoke planning and three-valued decision policy

synthetic_counterexamples: An egg-link that points outside /data/project is rejected.
An egg-link name that differs from project metadata after PEP 503 normalization is rejected.
Two matching project distributions are ambiguous and produce no accepted provenance.
A valid legacy link preserves explicit top_level and console metadata without guessing.
